phase: L1 mechanism, not strategy or qualification
hypothesis: At the same two-dog production policy, separate public target assignments may reduce duplicated exploration; losses and counterexamples remain outcomes.
pairing: S2/R2 use identical production prerequisites, request conditions, no replacement, completion/abandonment rules and command cadence; only target allocation differs.
layoutRegistration: Actual deterministic legal building placement, public route points, empty point and opposite-player target placement must be written and hashed by setup-only mode before running outcomes. Infeasible layouts are errors, not silently dropped maps.
controls: hidden target permutation before first legal discovery
telemetry: own queue remaining paid and unpaid balance
observer real newly explored tile union and coverage curve
actual damage/loss and opponent entry visibility
prohibitedChanges: hidden enemy locations as route input
interpretation: Preplaced facilities isolate mechanics and do not measure normal MCV opening opportunity cost.
Paid production correctness, exploration outcome and full-match strength are separate.
No strength pass/fail is attached to L1; all runs are mechanisms, not 27000-tick draws.
Per-unit reveal credit is null unless causally observed; report team union otherwise.
C18 under a changed observation contract is not alone a pure causal control; L2 also needs the same-contract preceding frozen source and a route-only ablation.
